import hashlib
import pytest

from subject import verify_companion_attestation, HandlerOccCompanionAttestation
from omnimarket.nodes.node_occ_companion_compute.models.model_occ_companion_request import ModelOccCompanionRequest
from omnimarket.nodes.node_occ_companion_compute.models.model_occ_companion_plan import ModelCompanionFile
from omnimarket.nodes.node_occ_companion_compute.models.model_occ_attestation_result import ModelOccAttestationRequest
from omnimarket.nodes.node_occ_companion_compute.handlers.handler_occ_companion_compute import compute_companion_plan, deterministic_fingerprint


def _make_request(repo="acme/widget", pr_number=42, contract_hash="0x1234", receipt_hash="0xabcd"):
    return ModelOccCompanionRequest(
        repo=repo,
        pr_number=pr_number,
        contract_hash=contract_hash,
        receipt_hash=receipt_hash,
    )


def _make_observed_files(request):
    plan = compute_companion_plan(request)
    return tuple(plan.files)


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_verify_companion_attestation_accepted_when_reproducible():
    request = _make_request()
    observed_files = _make_observed_files(request)
    result = verify_companion_attestation(observed_files, request)
    assert result.accepted is True
    assert result.observed_digest == result.expected_digest
    assert "ACCEPTED" in result.reason


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_verify_companion_attestation_rejected_when_tampered():
    request = _make_request()
    observed_files = _make_observed_files(request)
    tampered_files = tuple(
        ModelCompanionFile(
            path=f.path,
            content=f.content + "tampered",
        )
        for f in observed_files
    )
    result = verify_companion_attestation(tampered_files, request)
    assert result.accepted is False
    assert result.observed_digest != result.expected_digest
    assert "REJECTED" in result.reason


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_verify_companion_attestation_rejected_when_stale_request():
    request = _make_request()
    observed_files = _make_observed_files(request)
    stale_request = _make_request(contract_hash="0xdeadbeef")
    result = verify_companion_attestation(observed_files, stale_request)
    assert result.accepted is False
    assert "REJECTED" in result.reason


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_verify_companion_attestation_rejected_when_missing_files():
    request = _make_request()
    observed_files = _make_observed_files(request)
    if observed_files:
        truncated_files = observed_files[:-1]
    else:
        truncated_files = observed_files
    result = verify_companion_attestation(truncated_files, request)
    if len(truncated_files) != len(observed_files):
        assert result.accepted is False
        assert "REJECTED" in result.reason
    else:
        assert result.accepted is True
